'''2007 Worlds Team Micah Wooten DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wooten]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Sheet Moose Wooten → Micah Wooten. Deck title Tag, Your It!!

* '''Player:''' [[Micah Wooten]]

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
